overview.description: RT-qPCR transforms RNA into cDNA via reverse transcriptase, then quantifies it in real time. It's the gold standard for measuring gene expression - but genomic-DNA contamination causes false positives, so clean RNA matters.

steps.description: RT-qPCR transforms RNA into cDNA via reverse transcriptase, then quantifies it in real time. It's the gold standard for measuring gene expression - but genomic-DNA contamination causes false positives, so clean RNA matters.
steps.intro: RT-qPCR transforms RNA into cDNA via reverse transcriptase, then quantifies it in real time. It's the gold standard for measuring gene expression - but genomic-DNA contamination causes false positives, so clean RNA matters.

instructions.title: Reverse transcribe
instructions.description: Convert purified RNA to cDNA with reverse transcriptase.

instructions.title: Set up qPCR
instructions.description: Design specific primers (often spanning exon junctions); include no-RT and no-template controls.

instructions.title: Quantify
instructions.description: Run real-time PCR and interpret Ct values for relative or absolute quantification.

submission.description: Design an RT-qPCR assay (primers + controls) for a target transcript and outline how you'd interpret the Ct data.

kits.name: Open qPCR machine
kits.note: An accessible real-time PCR instrument for RT-qPCR and quantitation.

kits.name: RT-qPCR reagent kit
kits.note: Reverse-transcription + qPCR master mixes; include a -RT control.
